rules: In inert static HTML previews, header meta elements are limited to charset=UTF-8 (or utf8) with no other attributes, or the exact name/content attribute pair with name=viewport. No http-equiv metadata is permitted.

Omit meta http-equiv=Cache-Control content=no-store from the INERT HTML preview. Keep genuine source cache declarations in the existing source-backed prose/evidence where relevant; this preview-format rule adds no source or business fact and proves no runtime cache behavior.

Do not use iframe elements or src=about:blank transport in inert static HTML previews. Represent a source iframe region with an inert div and data-source-element="iframe", preserving the exact source value labels and source-backed layout where observed. Describe genuine source iframe and cache behavior in source-backed prose/evidence; an inert preview proves no runtime behavior.

Return the complete source-backed Markdown after this format correction. Preserve the full execution context, source boundaries, factual branches, canonical structures and independent review requirements.
